contracts.name: sumNumericFields
contracts.signature: function sumNumericFields(text: string, separator: string, fallback: number): number

preconditions: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Separator is nonempty; fields have at most 20 characters and accepted values are finite between -1000 and 1000. Fallback is finite between -1000 and 1000.
